comments.author: @tomaud
comments.text: The author of this video should familiarise himself with Hungarian pronunciations before creating a video on Hungary. Magyar is not pronounced as Magyar but Modyor and utca (street) is not utka but uttsa or ootza. And so on and so forth. And I know this for decades now (out of respect) even that I do not speak Hungarian. It takes just a few seconds to learn those before creating an "educational" video (or making a bit of a fool for yourself).

comments.text: The historical research in this script is phenomenal.
